title: Managing Plexiform Neurofibroma and Other Complications of Neurofibromatosis Type 1 in the Adult Neurology Clinic: A Review.
snippet: Loss-of-function variants in thegene result in the development of neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1), a neurogenetic disease and multisystem disorder that includes a predilection for benign and malignant tumors of the central and peripheral nervous systems.
